ترتضخون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَضِخُونَ (tartaḍiḵūna) /tar.ta.dˤi.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# تُرْتَضَخُونَ (turtaḍaḵūna) /tur.ta.dˤa.xuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
